messages:
alex.s: Quick heads-up 12: I pulled a rollup of incident causes over the last 12 weeks. Three recurring buckets: autoscaler oscillations during bursts, cold-start latency for low-tier model pools, and cache eviction storms tied to nightly ETL. Opening thread to assign owners and short timelines.
marie_ops: can you drop counts?
alex.s: Sure 12: autoscaler-related: 9 incidents (median recovery ~7m), cold-start latency: 14 regressions (heavy on small pools), cache-eviction storms: 5 notable events correlated with batch windows.
jamal_eng: Noted. Do we know deploy overlap for autoscaler events?
sophia_sre: Context: 3 autoscaler incidents coincided with infra deploys that changed pod anti-affinity; packing got worse and scale decisions oscillated.
lia_pm: Which customer types were hit most? Hosted vs Dedicated?
tariq_reliability: Autoscaler hit Hosted prod and 2 Dedicated tenants; cold-starts mainly impacted Dedicated customers on tiny pools; cache storms were mostly internal but bumped billing metrics that customers sometimes see.
marie_ops: Proposal: 3 remediation tracks. Each needs an owner, an initial 2-week plan with deliverables, and a 30-day checkpoint. Volunteers?
jamal_eng: I can own autoscaler with @sophia_sre. Plan: repro with synthetic bursts, tune scaleDown/scaleUp thresholds, add stabilization windows, and add a pre-warm hook for critical routes. Deliverable: config PR + staging canary in 10 business days.
sophia_sre: I'll update runbooks and add a deploy checklist for any autoscaler config change. Also we'll add an alarm for repeated scale events within 5m.
lia_pm: I'll prepare customer comms templates for affected tenants and coordinate with sales for any credits.
tariq_reliability: I'll lead cold-starts. Plan: quantify cold-start tail per model/profile, enable warm-pool for high-risk models, and prototype microVM warmers. Deliverable: dashboard + pilot for two models in 12 days.
alex.s: Cache eviction storms 12 who owns?
marie_ops: Ops + infra can take it. Short plan: audit cache TTLs, add write-rate backpressure for nightly ETL, and set a per-tenant eviction cap. Add gating tests in QA. Target: configs + tests in 14 days.
jamal_eng: I'll open a ticket for autoscaler changes: RED-9001. Include roll-forward and rollback play.
sophia_sre: Runbook entries to create: RM-190 (autoscaler), RM-191 (cold-starts), RM-192 (cache-eviction). I'll attach links in-thread once created.
inc-bot: Incident bot: created follow-up tasks: RED-9001 (autoscaler), RED-9002 (cold-starts), RED-9003 (cache audit) and assigned to owners.
lia_pm: Checkpoints: weekly async updates + 30d review. First 30d checkpoint timestamp set to 1781844676.
tariq_reliability: I'll post weekly notes.
marie_ops: I'll draft a risk matrix mapping each remediation to deploy/perf/config risks so SRE can gate changes. Draft by EOD.
jamal_eng: For autoscaler I'd like a CI synthetic job to validate infra PRs. Example stub: ```bash
# synthetic 2m burst against staging
./tools/synth_burst --target staging --rate 600 --duration 120
```
lia_pm: I'll drop a customer-facing template in #customer-success and link it here.
sophia_sre: Short-term mitigations until fixes: 1) conservative scaleDown on prod, 2) pin most-critical tenants to reserved nodes for 2 weeks, 3) bump trace sampling around bursts.
tariq_reliability: Recommend recurring quarterly "pattern audit" in ops calendar so these trends are reviewed proactively.
alex.s: Action summary (to paste into tickets): - Autoscaler (owner: jamal_eng + sophia_sre) -> PR + canary in 10bd -> RED-9001. - Cold-starts (owner: tariq_reliability) -> pilot warm pool + dashboard -> RED-9002. - Cache eviction (owner: marie_ops + infra) -> TTL audit + backpressure -> RED-9003. Checkpoint: 1781844676. Weekly status in #incidents.
marie_ops: I'll post the weekly status and update ticket links.
lia_pm: If you need short-lived infra for testing ping me 12 I can provision.
jamal_eng: I'll post first repro notes EOD tomorrow.
sophia_sre: Runbook drafts before checkpoint.
inc-bot: Incident bot: reminder set for 1781844676 (30d follow-up).
alex.s: Closing thread 12 keep updates in the RED tickets and cc this thread for public posts. :thumbsup:
